key_insight: VerifiedLab turns scientific records into machine-usable evidence, coordinating AI agents to check claims against data reliability before releasing them.
engineering_relevance: For perovskite solar-cell research, the framework supports evidence-grounded analysis and prediction while tracking how far the underlying literature can be trusted.
method: Verify research records field by field.
Assign AI agents to planning, evidence computation, drafting, and review.
Use reliability-aware checks to release or withhold claims.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that perovskite solar-cell experiments recovered known physical trends and anticipated devices reported a year later, but provides no quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: Practical adoption depends on the quality of record verification and the inference-time compute required for claim checking.
